title: Custom Tailoring
intro: Personal tailoring for men and women, from suits and executive outfits to formalwear shaped around your preferences.
audience: Men and women planning a custom suit, formal outfit or professional wardrobe.
options: Discuss suits, jackets, trousers, skirts or other garment requirements, your design references and available fabric choices. The team confirms what is feasible before an order is agreed.
steps: Share your references, garment category and intended occasion.
Discuss fabric selection, design details, measurements and a quote before ordering.
Agree production arrangements, attend fitting appointments and confirm collection or delivery with the team.
sections: Clothing for men and women
Discuss custom suits, jackets, trousers, skirts, formalwear and executive outfits. Start with a reference photograph or a conversation about the garment you need.
Designed around your preferences
Explore the design, proportions, colours and available fabric options with the team. Final details, materials and feasibility are agreed before an order.
Bring your ideas or your fabric

Bring sketches, reference photographs or cloth you already own. Discuss the design direction and ask the team to assess fabric quantity, suitability and any additional materials before agreeing the garment.
Measurements, fittings and finish
Arrange personal measurements, discuss fit and attend the agreed fitting appointments. Production timing and collection or delivery arrangements are confirmed for your order.
requirements: Fabric preferences or fabric you already own
Available measurements and preferred fitting arrangements

title: Wedding & Civil Wedding Tailoring
intro: A personal tailoring conversation for your ceremony, civil wedding or wedding celebrations.
audience: Customers preparing a wedding or civil-wedding outfit.
options: Discuss your ceremony, preferred silhouette, colours and coordination needs. Specific details and fabric availability are confirmed with the team.
steps: Share your occasion and event date.
Discuss your reference, garment requirements and available options.
Agree measurements, fitting arrangements and a feasible schedule.
sections: For your ceremony
Discuss a custom suit, tuxedo request or women’s formalwear for a wedding or civil ceremony. Your reference guides the conversation; the team confirms which design details can be made.
A look that belongs to you
Discuss silhouette, colour, available fabrics and any coordination requirements. No package or fixed price is implied by a reference photograph.
Plan the fittings
Tell us the ceremony date early. Measurements, fitting appointments and a feasible production schedule are agreed individually; submitting an enquiry does not guarantee a deadline.
requirements: Wedding or civil ceremony and event date
visualAlt: Black formalwear on a mannequin, shown as design inspiration

title: Graduation Tailoring
intro: Made-to-order outfit enquiries for a milestone worth remembering.
audience: Graduates planning an outfit for their ceremony or celebration.
options: Discuss suit or outfit styling, your preferred colours and the practical needs of your ceremony.
steps: Tell us your graduation date and preferred outfit.
Share a reference and discuss the details.
Confirm measurements, fittings and timing before ordering.
sections: An outfit for your milestone
Discuss graduation clothing for men or women, including a suit or another outfit developed from your references.
Your design, considered
Talk through the silhouette, colours and available fabric choices. Confirm the final garment details with the team before ordering.
Ready for the fitting conversation
Share your graduation date, arrange measurements and agree fitting appointments. Timing and collection arrangements depend on the garment and confirmed capacity.

title: Mobile Fitting
intro: A measurement or fitting appointment at your location in Kigali, arranged directly with the Mr Sewing team.
audience: Customers who would like to request measurements or a fitting at home, at an office or at a hotel in Kigali.
options: Share your address, garment needs, any existing measurements and your preferred dates. Coverage, visit charges and availability must be confirmed; a message is a request, not a booked appointment.
steps: Request a visit with your Kigali location, garment details and preferred dates.
The team confirms whether a visit is possible and agrees the appointment and any charges.
Prepare your reference images and garments for fitting. Discuss measurements, fit requirements and any follow-up appointment during the visit.
sections: The appointment comes to you
Request measurements or fitting support at a home, office or hotel in Kigali. This is an appointment request, not a promise of coverage or an available slot.
Before the visit
Share your address and access details, garment needs, reference images and preferred dates. Have the relevant garment available if you are requesting a fitting.
During and after a fitting
Discuss your measurements and fit requirements with the team. Any follow-up fitting, travel charge and scheduling details must be confirmed directly.
requirements: Your location in Kigali and contact number
Garment and measurement or fitting needs
Preferred dates and suitable appointment times
Existing garments, references or measurements to discuss

title: Premium Garment Care
intro: A dedicated care conversation for your garments. Confirm available services, suitability and conditions with Mr Sewing.
audience: Customers seeking care guidance for an eligible Mr Sewing order.
options: Care options and eligibility depend on the garment and order. Complimentary cleaning or gifts are not universal benefits; confirm the applicable conditions.
steps: Share the order or garment details.
Ask which care options and conditions apply.
Agree the next step with the team.

title: Alterations & Refinements
intro: Garment adjustments assessed around the fit and changes you need.
audience: Customers seeking adjustments to an existing suit, jacket, trousers, dress or skirt.
options: Possible requests include resizing, sleeve or hem adjustments, zipper or button repairs and lining work. Suitability is assessed before a quote.
steps: Describe the garment and the changes you would like.
Arrange an assessment of fit, condition and construction.
Confirm the work, quote and fitting arrangements.
sections: Refine the fit you have
Request an assessment of a suit, jacket, trousers, dress or skirt. The garment’s condition and construction determine which adjustments are possible.
Changes to discuss
Existing booking options include resizing and tapering, sleeve or hem adjustments, zipper or button repairs and lining work. Each request is assessed; not every change is suitable for every garment.
Assessment before a quote
Describe the fit concern and arrange an assessment. The team confirms the work, price, fitting needs and estimated timing before you agree.
requirements: Garment type and current fit concern
Photographs or a clear description of the requested change
visualAlt: Tape measuring a shirt at chest level, shown as a fit illustration

title: Express Tailoring
intro: Discuss an urgent tailoring request and confirm whether the team can meet your deadline.
audience: Customers with an approaching event or urgent garment requirement.
options: Share the garment, exact date, measurements and fabric preferences. Availability, charges and timing require explicit confirmation; an enquiry does not reserve production.
steps: Contact the team with your exact deadline.
Discuss the garment and whether express capacity is available.
Proceed only after the team confirms the requirements and arrangements.
sections: An urgent request, carefully assessed
Express tailoring is considered against the garment, materials, measurements and current capacity. Eligibility is confirmed individually; there is no published blanket deadline.
Tell us the exact deadline
Send the date and time you need the garment, the garment type and a design reference. Explain whether fabric and measurements are already available.
Confirmation before production
The team must confirm feasibility, any express fees, payment requirements and the agreed schedule. Opening an enquiry does not reserve production capacity or confirm an order.
requirements: Your contact details for direct confirmation
